annotation.bound_parties_text: The guidance applies to all joint and single-Service personnel and civilians employed in duties relating to procuring, operating and supporting unmanned and remotely piloted aircraft systems.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: applicable to all joint and single-Service personnel and civilians employed in duties relating to procuring, operating and supporting unmanned and remotely piloted aircraft systems.
annotation.dates_quote: 12 September 2017 First published. This publication was withdrawn on 16 November 2022
annotation.robot_provision_quote: Joint Doctrine Publication 0-30.2 describes the use of unmanned aircraft systems at the operational level.
